brief: Checks if an rfc822Name matches a complete or partial pattern
description:
Returns true if value matches pattern, a complete or partial rfc822Name.

If pattern is a complete mailbox, such as "Anderson@sun.com", it matches that mailbox: the local part exactly and the domain part ignoring case.

If pattern is a domain, such as "sun.com", it matches every mailbox at exactly that domain (ignoring case), not at its subdomains.

If pattern is a domain that starts with ".", such as ".east.sun.com", it matches every mailbox in a subdomain of it, such as "Anderson@a.east.sun.com", but not at "east.sun.com" itself.

parameters.description: A mailbox, a domain, or a domain that starts with ".".
parameters.name: pattern
